subject: Fix EntryTest.entryUpdate failure on macOS due to allocator differences (#3398)
reason: The change modifies only src/unit/test_entry.cpp, a unit test: it shortens test string values so EntryTest.entryUpdate's assumptions about embedded-entry allocation sizes (the 3/4 threshold cases) hold under macOS's allocator as well as jemalloc, and fixes a comment numbering typo. No server code, command behaviour, reply, replication, persistence or memory-management path changes, so there is no runtime behaviour for a scenario to reach.
